ruleDefinitions.name: Credential Dumping Activity By Python Based Tool
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects LSASS process access for potential credential dumping by a Python-like tool such as LaZagne or Pypykatz. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, CallTrace, GrantedAccess

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND (CallTrace = RGX(".*\\_ctypes\\\.pyd\\+.*") AND CallTrace = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\KERNELBASE\\\.dll\\+.*") AND CallTrace = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SYSTEM32\\\\ntdll\\\.dll\\+.*")) AND (CallTrace = RGX(".*python27\\\.dll\\+.*") OR CallTrace = RGX(".*python3*\\\.dll\\+.*")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x1FFFFF")
